criteria.criterion: After a review, coverage.metrics contains input/output/cache token totals that include Pass-1 and prerequisite calls (checked: pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py summing FakeRunner stub usage).
The sidecar payload carries coverage.usage.per_call (raw call records with criteria lists) and coverage.usage.per_criterion under exactly those keys (checked: sidecar payload unit test).

A multi-criterion chunk divides token fields equally across its criteria and counts llm_calls in full per criterion; ladder-retry attempts each contribute a call record (checked: dedicated unit tests for both rules).
Missing _usage on any call degrades to zero contribution (checked: unit test).

Every caller of the three changed pass functions and of run_focused_finder — including eval_solver.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and criterion_preview.py — is updated in this change and the existing pass1, batch-runner, eval, and finalize test suites pass unmodified in behavior (checked: full pytest tests/unit/ run).
A checkpoint-resumed chunk contributes no usage and run_focused_finder's usage equals the sum over its internal run_bin calls (checked: dedicated unit tests).
